description: Update selected tool fields. Omitted fields retain their values.

data.description: Resource fields. Creating a tool returns its signing secret once. Configuring a tool does not invoke its URL; attached tools can call it during conversations. Additional settings are documented in https://apifleet.dev/docs

name.description: Function name: letters, digits and underscore; cannot start with a digit.

url.description: Public HTTPS callback URL; private network targets are rejected.

id.description: Resource identifier returned by a previous request.
